pageInstruction: Listen to your teacher. Do one part at a time.
sectionLead: Two short paper checks made from this unit's own worksheets. Give Check A before you teach the unit and Check B after it, and you can see what changed. Each part belongs to one lesson.
sectionHonest: This is a classroom check of this unit's lessons. It is not a standardized test, and its points are not a grade.
notCovered: Not in the check: {lessons}. Worksheets that cannot be split into single tasks are left out.
formsNote: Printing a check counts as a download, like any worksheet.
teacherPages: Teacher pages: points, class record, and what to do next
teacherNote: The answer keys and the teacher pages come with the paid {plan} plan.
tpHow1: Give Check A before you start the unit and Check B when you finish it. Both checks ask the same kinds of tasks with different numbers, words, and pictures. Before Check A, tell the children that they have not learned these things yet and that it is fine to skip a part.
tpHow2: Read each direction aloud, one part at a time. The check is about what each part asks, not about reading the directions.
tpHow3: Give one point for each task box that is completely right. In a box that says to circle every shape, give the point only when all the right shapes and no others are circled.
tpHonest: This is a classroom check of this unit's lessons. It is not a standardized test. The points show you where to look again; they are not a grade, and they say nothing about a child beyond these tasks.
tpGridLead: Write each child's points for every part, Check A on the left and Check B on the right. After Check B, a part where a child does not have all the points is a part to look at again.
tpNextLead: For each part, go back to the lesson it belongs to. Every worksheet and activity named here is linked on the unit's web page.
tpStillEasier: Teach Lesson {n} again. Then use the easier version of “{title}” for more practice.
tpEasyHarder: Use the harder version of “{title}” as a challenge.
tpEasyOn: No extra practice is needed for this lesson.
